subject: Sponsor roster, procurement steps & steerco logistics
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:10:00 -0400
Subject: Sponsor roster, procurement steps & steerco logistics

Hi Daniel —

Great talking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track: 

• Call takeaways (attached): mutual interest in a pilot focused on prediction workflows for claims triage, success metric = 15% reduction in manual review volume.
• Decision criteria you listed: accuracy for prioritized intents, latency under 200ms 95th, and SLA/MTTR for regressions.
• Security/legal/procurement: you mentioned legal + procurement review before PO. Can you confirm the names and timelines?
• Exec sponsor / steerco: we’ll need an exec sponsor + steering committee for approval and go/no-go. Can you confirm the economic buyer and who typically sits on your steerco?

Attachments: post-call-notes.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft MAP with milestones).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm economic buyer and legal/procurement contacts (by EOD Wed) — we’ll kick off an evidence packet.
2) We’ll send a 30–45 minute steerco agenda + invite for the week of Nov 1 if that works for your team.
3) Rishi will prepare a brief procurement checklist and pricing scenarios for the steerco.

If helpful I can also draft the invite text for your execs.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Attachments: post-call-notes.pdf (4 pages), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (1 sheet)
From: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Meera Patel <meera.patel@acmehealth.com>, Jordan Smith <j.smith@acmehealth.com>, procure@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sponsor roster, procurement steps & steerco logistics

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 

• Economic buyer: Meera Patel (CFO). She wants to see clear ROI and procurement impact for FY27 budgets.
• Legal: Jordan Smith, Senior Counsel. Expect a 2–3 week review for standard agreements, longer if we need custom terms.
• Procurement: procure@acmehealth.com handles PO issuance and standard vendor setup (usually 1–2 weeks once legal signoff).
• Steering committee: typically Meera + the VP of Ops (Lara Chen) + IT security (Antonio Ruiz) + a business unit director (we’ll confirm the exact person).

For the steerco format, a 30-minute exec-level briefing + 15-minute Q&A works best for us. If you can share a one-pager and attach a short cost/benefit slide that would help.

I can tentatively pencil in Thurs, Nov 3 at 11am ET for the steerco — pending internal confirmation.

Also: Jordan asked if you can provide SOC2 documentation and an architecture diagram we can hand to security.

I’ll loop in the rest once Meera and Lara are available.

Best,
Daniel
Senior Director, Digital Transformation | Acme Health
D: +1 (212) 555-2334

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sponsor roster, procurement steps & steerco logistics

Daniel —

Appreciate the clarity. We’ll prepare the packet Jordan requested and draft an executive one-pager tailored to Meera. Quick internal mapping so everyone knows roles on our side: 

• Executive sponsor / steerco presenter: Evelyn Hart (SVP, Commercial) — will lead the 10–12 minute executive brief.
• Deal lead / commercial questions: Rishi Malhotra — will own pricing scenarios and PO flow.
• Customer success / pilot ops: Marissa Cole — will lay out the pilot plan and KPIs.

I attached a draft steerco agenda (steerco-agenda-draft.md) and a short checklist Rishi will use for procurement prep. Proposed agenda items: 1) Exec context + ROI (Evelyn) 2) Pilot design and metrics (Marissa) 3) Sec/compliance and timelines (short slide) 4) Commercial ask and next steps (Rishi).

We’ll assemble SOC2 evidence and an architecture diagram — expect the packet by EOD Fri (Oct 23).

Does Nov 3, 11am ET still look good from your side? If so, we’ll send a calendar invite with the one-pager and procurement checklist attached.

Thanks —
Aditya

---
Attachment: steerco-agenda-draft.md
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sponsor roster, procurement steps & steerco logistics

Aditya / team —

I can present for the steerco. Suggest we run a 30-minute prep call the day before (Nov 2) to align talking points and confirm the ROI slide. My time windows: Nov 2 between 9–11am ET or 4–5pm ET.

Also: I want the cost buckets clearly split (pilot discount, GA price, support uplift). Rishi — please prepare two pricing scenarios: pilot (6 weeks) and enterprise (12 months).

Evelyn
SVP, Commercial | Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sponsor roster, procurement steps & steerco logistics

Thanks, all —

Nov 3, 11am ET works for Meera and the rest of the committee. I’ve attached our internal procurement checklist so you can see their usual gating items (procurement-checklist.docx).

Jordan: please review the SOC2 + architecture diagram when Aditya sends the packet. Procurement: once legal signs, we can turn around a PO within 3 business days.

I’ll send a formal calendar invite to Meera, Lara, and Antonio after you share the one-pager.

Regards,
Daniel
